text:
zoe: Quick design review 1: compact invite row in Org settings. Keyboard users report Invite CTA is read after role and kebab. We should make primary action appear earlier in DOM. image: https://img.redwood.local/ux/compact-invite-row.png :mag: max: Agree. Current visual order shows role left, invite right via flex order. Problem is DOM follows visual order so SR users hear role first. pablo: Small change: reorder DOM to: avatar > heading > invite button > role chip > kebab. Then use CSS to preserve visual layout. Avoid tabindex fiddling. kate: FYI moving DOM can affect focus outlines and analytic selectors. We'll need to update QA tests and any e2e selectors that target the invite button position. zoe: Also copy tweak for the invite button aria-label: change to "Invite people to " so SR gets context. And add an sr-only description when a default role will be applied: "Invite 1 assigns \u2018Viewer\u2019 role". screen-reader-bot: Audit notes: 1) keep logical DOM order matching action priority; 2) avoid duplicate hidden buttons; 3) aria-describedby for outcome text only; 4) ensure kebab is after primary actions in tab order. max: Another minor point: when SSO enforcement toggle lives in org settings header, toggling it can change who can invite. We should surface a short inline hint below the invite row when SSO is on: "SSO enforced 1 invitations restricted to members". Make that hint aria-live polite so SR users get it when they toggle. pablo: Implementation note: aria-live will announce on toggle but be careful about repeated announcements when rendering lists. Use sr-only region with id that we update only on changes. kate: Accessibility handoff: please include VoiceOver and NVDA snippets in the PR description showing before/after phonetic output. Also update component unit tests to assert aria-label and aria-describedby presence. zoe: Example JSX sketch: ```
\n \n
\n

Project Phoenix

\n \n Invite 1 assigns 'Viewer' role\n Viewer\n \n
\n
\n/* Use CSS grid to visually place role-chip before invite on small screens */ ``` max: Sounds good. Also ensure focus-visible outline is preserved on the invite button after DOM reorder. pablo: I'll update CSS and add a11y tests. Will also look at analytics selectors. kate: Copy approves the aria-label and the sr-only phrasing. One ask: use curly quotes in the sr-only text for clarity? prefer single straight quotes for consistency with other sr text. screen-reader-bot: Final checklist: 1) DOM: invite before role; 2) invite aria-label includes project; 3) sr-only outcome text via aria-describedby; 4) kebab last; 5) announce SSO toggle changes via aria-live polite; 6) contrast check for role-chip when interactive; 7) update tests and e2e selectors. zoe: Can we target beta this sprint? Small PR with screenshots + VoiceOver and NVDA notes would help. pablo: I'll own the PR. will tag @kate for copy and @max for QA. :rocket:
